Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus: Built Heritage

A 105-minute heritage walk in the Fort precinct, Mumbai

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you understand railway architecture and public movement as urban history.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Station exterior and accessible viewpoints
  • Rail heritage and urban growth
  • Architectural motifs
  • Compare original and present public flows

How the time is spent

  1. Station exterior and accessible viewpoints 15 min

  2. Rail heritage and urban growth 35 min

  3. Architectural motifs 35 min

  4. Compare original and present public flows 20 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.
